keyboard_surface_label: Example State official voter-information keyboard navigation and focus fail-open policy
delivery_role_note: Critical official voter-information routes remain reachable, visibly focused, and logically ordered for keyboard-only navigation rather than assuming pointer input is the only real path to the answer.
real_control_semantics_note: Critical actions use real links, buttons, or equivalently keyboard-operable controls rather than click-only facsimiles.
focus_visibility_note: Focus remains visibly identifiable on interactive controls throughout the reviewed answer lane.
focus_order_note: Focus order follows the visible task order closely enough that voters do not lose orientation while moving through the route.
keyboard_trap_review_note: Reviewed widgets, disclosures, and utility controls do not trap keyboard focus or create dead-end paths.
dynamic_update_continuity_note: Lookups, disclosures, and route-state changes preserve a coherent focus path to the next relevant control or answer region.
validation_and_error_focus_note: Validation messages and correction paths stay attached to the relevant field and do not strand keyboard users away from the needed fix.
same_answer_across_input_modes_note: Keyboard traversal may change interaction cues but does not silently change the underlying authoritative answer.
manual_help_contact_note: A visible first-party help/contact lane remains available when the keyboard path becomes confusing or a control-specific failure is discovered.
